WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM Customer c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
), shares AS (
    SELECT CustomerId,
           total_spent,
           total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS revenue_share
    FROM customer_totals
), measured AS (
    SELECT total_spent,
           revenue_share,
           AVG(revenue_share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS average_total_spent,
       AVG(revenue_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(revenue_share - average_share) AS average_share_difference
FROM measured
WHERE revenue_share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: Customers with no invoices count toward the overall customer average with total spent and revenue share of zero; overall revenue is assumed nonzero.
